US Ambassador: Modi Would Be Trump's Top Choice for Meeting

US Ambassador to India, Sergio Goray, stated that Prime Minister Narendra Modi would be at the top of President Donald Trump's list if he were to meet with 35 world leaders. Goray highlighted the strengthening India-US relationship, citing growing cooperation in Quad, defense, trade, and investment. He also suggested that the world is envious of the robust India-US ties, attributing the stability in these relations to Prime Minister Modi. Goray made these remarks in an interview with Aaj Tak, emphasizing that India-US relations are currently at a historic high.
